label: Indicative carbon-cost context
uka_price_basis: GOV.UK UK ETS CCM monthly average futures price

rows.label: UK generation average context
rows.factor_basis: GOV.UK FMD 2025-26 UK generation average factor

rows.label: FMD residual mix context
rows.factor_basis: GOV.UK FMD 2025-26 residual mix context factor

rows.label: Natural gas proxy
rows.factor_basis: GOV.UK FMD 2025-26 natural gas emissions factor proxy

methodology_note: Indicative carbon cost per MWh = UKA GBP/tCO2 (latest official GOV.UK monthly average) * emissions factor tCO2/MWh. This is market and fossil/residual exposure context only: not a bill calculation, not a power-price forecast, not a REGO claim validation input, and not an official customer emissions result.
